sv.title: ChatGPT gav råd om svensk skolattack i test
sv.summary: Ekots reportrar lyckades få hjälp med att planera en fiktiv svensk skolattack genom ChatGPT. Detta trots att företaget bakom AI-verktyget tidigare uppgett att man skärpt säkerheten.

en.title: ChatGPT gave advice on a Swedish school attack in test
en.summary: Ekot's reporters managed to get help planning a fictional Swedish school attack through ChatGPT. This despite the company behind the AI tool having previously stated that it had tightened its security.
